search_surface: Conan Center Index recipe tree (GitHub git-trees API), plus targeted C XML recipe names; adoption from Debian popcon sourcemax installation counts

search.method: literal case-insensitive recipe-name substring; alphabetic, not usage ranked

adoption_metric.name: Debian popcon installations of the lead's runtime library binary package (max when two sonames are listed)

homebrew_cross_check.name: Homebrew install count (365 days, includes dependency installs)

glib2.0 (GMarkup).primary_note: Unranked: glib2.0 builds all of GLib (GLib, GObject, GIO, GModule), so its runtime counts are not XML-specific; Debian has no GMarkup-specific development package, so the protocol's binary dev-package fallback has no row.

ixml.debian_sourcemax_note: The libupnp/pupnp sources build both libupnp and libixml, so the source count is not IXML-specific; the format-specific runtime binary is used, as for the other C XML paths.

debian_source_search.method: case-insensitive substring 'xml' in Debian source-package names of the hashed sourcemax/by_inst table; ordered by installations; every hit recorded and classified
debian_source_search.limit_note: All hits are recorded and classified; the protocol's 100-result inspection bound is exceeded here, as in the C++ JSON Debian search, because the list is cheap to classify by name.
